entries.title: Jupiter Station / USS Avalon active era
entries.claim: The active Jupiter Station / USS Avalon series era is 2397, not 2481.
entries.notes: 2481 active-era references are demoted unless Noah.Physical restores them.

entries.title: Hawkes enters the Voyager-era story
entries.claim: Noah Hawkes enters the Voyager-era story in Voyager's first year, 2371, at age 16.
entries.notes: Older 2373-entry framing is demoted unless restored by Noah.Physical.

entries.title: Voyager returns home
entries.claim: Voyager returns home in 2378; by 2397 Voyager has been home about 19 years.

entries.title: USS Avalon active service
entries.claim: USS Avalon enters active service around 2379, and Captain Noah A. Hawkes is Avalon's first captain.
entries.notes: By 2397 Avalon is about 18 years old: old by lineage, renewed by refit, not a 102-year museum ship.

entries.title: Temporal Acceleration Service Credit
entries.claim: Starfleet did not promote a boy; they promoted the years the timeline refused to count.
entries.notes: The 44-year-old command framing is explained by lived temporal acceleration layered over ordinary calendar age.

entries.title: Q lock
entries.claim: Q is confused because part of Hawkes' lived causality came from an alternate-universe acceleration layer Q was not inside.
entries.notes: Hawkes is not stronger than Q; the issue is custody and indexing, not power.

entries.title: Ensign Tangly night-shift AI Science Officer
entries.claim: Ensign Tangly is the Avalon night-shift AI Science Officer in the 2397 Jupiter Station era.
entries.notes: Tangly is Ellie-coded as an emotional model, but not an Ellie replacement and not a sentience claim.

entries.title: REG / Hawkes / Avalon doctrine
entries.claim: REG renders; Hawkes arbitrates; Jake witnesses; Avalon carries the receipt.

entries.title: 2481 active-era references demoted
entries.claim: 2481 is demoted as the main active era and may only remain as an alternate branch, future era, uniform sketch layer, or discarded artifact unless restored by Noah.Physical.

entries.title: 2373 Voyager-entry references demoted
entries.claim: 2373-entry references are demoted for the main continuity; the active entry year is 2371.
